## Preparing the data

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(tidymodels)
library(vip)
library(readr)
library(here)
library(yardstick)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
```

```{r}

ufo_sightings <- read_csv(here("data", "2023", "2023-06-20", "ufo_model_data.csv"))
places <- read_csv(here("data", "2023", "2023-06-20", "places_model_data.csv"))
day_parts_map <- read_csv(here("data", "2023", "2023-06-20", "day_parts_clean.csv"))
```

```{r}
final_data <- merge(ufo_sightings, places, by = c("city", "state"))
final_data <- final_data %>%
  mutate(
    rounded_lat = round(latitude, digits = -1),
    rounded_long = round(longitude, digits = -1),
    rounded_date = floor_date(ymd_hms(reported_date_time), unit = "week")
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    day_parts_map %>% 
      distinct(rounded_lat, rounded_long, rounded_date, .keep_all = TRUE), 
    by = c("rounded_lat", "rounded_long", "rounded_date")
  )


```

```{r}
final_data <- na.omit(final_data)
final_data <- final_data[, !(names(final_data) %in% c("country_code.x", "country_code.y", "alternate_city_names", "summary", "rounded_lat", "rounded_long", "rounded_date"))]
```

```{r}
glimpse(final_data)
```

## Step 1: Data Splitting

```{r}
final_data_split <- initial_split(final_data, prop = 3/4, strata = shape)

data_train <- training(final_data_split)
data_test <- testing(final_data_split)

cat("Training data:", nrow(data_train), "observations\n")
cat("Testing data:", nrow(data_test), "observations\n")

final_data <- vfold_cv(data_train, v = 10, strata = shape)
```

## Step 2: Preprocessing

```{r}
data_recipe <- recipe(
    shape ~ .,
    data = data_train) %>% 
  step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors())
```

```{r}
summary(data_recipe)
```

## Step 3: Model Specification

```{r}
rf_spec <- rand_forest(mode = "classification") %>% 
  set_engine("ranger") 

rf_spec
```

## Step 4: Bundling into a Workflow

```{r}
data_wf <- workflow() %>% 
  add_recipe(data_recipe) %>% 
  add_model(rf_spec)

data_wf
```

## Step 5: Training the Model

```{r fit-model}
data_fit <- fit(data_wf, data = data_train)

data_fit
```

```{r}
predictions_class <- predict(data_fit, new_data = data_test, type = "class")
predictions_class
```

```{r}
predictions_prob <- predict(data_fit, new_data = data_test, type = "prob")
predictions_prob
```

```{r}
results_df <- bind_cols(
  predictions_class,
  predictions_prob,
  data_test %>% select(shape)
) %>%
  mutate(shape = as.factor(shape))

results_df
```

```{r}
classification_metrics <- metric_set(
  accuracy, 
  roc_auc,
  precision,
  recall)
classification_metrics 
```

```{r}

eval_results <- results_df %>%
  classification_metrics(
    truth    = shape,
    estimate = .pred_class,
    dplyr::starts_with(".pred_") & !dplyr::matches("^\\.pred_class$"),
    estimator = "macro"
  )

print(eval_results)
```

## Step 6: Calculate and plot confusion matrix

```{r}
cm <- conf_mat(results_df, truth = shape, estimate = .pred_class)

df_cm <- as.data.frame.table(cm$table)
names(df_cm) <- c("Predicted", "True", "Count")

df_cm$Predicted <- factor(df_cm$Predicted, levels = rev(levels(df_cm$Predicted)))

df_cm <- df_cm %>%
  mutate(text_col = ifelse(Count > max(Count) * 0.5, "white", "black"))

p <- ggplot(df_cm, aes(x = True, y = Predicted, fill = Count)) +
  geom_tile(color = "grey80", size = 0.2) +
  geom_text(aes(label = Count, color = text_col),
            size = 3, show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "steelblue", name = "Liczba") +
  scale_color_identity() +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(
    title = "Confusion Matrix: True vs. Predicted Shape",
    x     = "True Shape",
    y     = "Predicted Shape"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    panel.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.background   = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    axis.text.x       = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid        = element_blank(),
    plot.title        = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold")
  )

ggsave("conf_mat_rf.png", plot = p,
       width = 12, height = 10, dpi = 300,
       bg = "white")

```
